summary: Pinecone enterprise contract negotiation and seat provisioning for vector search rollout
description:
Issue summary: Request procurement of an enterprise Pinecone contract to support Redwood's vector search + embeddings production rollout. We need seat provisioning, SSO/SAML, VPC peering, and an enterprise SLA. This ticket tracks negotiation, legal review, PO issuance, and seat provisioning coordination with Infra and Product teams.

Background: The Search & Retrieval team plans to move an internal pilot into production for the Redwood Console's semantic search and a few customer-facing features. Pilot used Pinecone managed service; scale and compliance requirements now require an enterprise contract and dedicated project management.

Requested timeline: contract signed + seats provisioned by 2026-03-31 to meet product release milestones.
impact: Delayed contract and seat provisioning blocks multiple product features in the Console and Dedicated onboarding flows. Could delay Q2 deliverables for search and increase cost if we remain on elevated metered usage. Not customer-facing yet, but impacts release schedules and infra readiness.
business_justification: Pinecone provides low-latency vector retrieval native to current embeddings stack; moving to an enterprise plan avoids metered overage costs, enables SSO and VPC peering for security requirements, and provides an SLA for production usage. Product ROI: reduced serving latency and predictable unit costs for embedding-backed features.
estimated_cost: $120,000/year (vendor quote preliminary) — final cost to be confirmed with procurement and finance
legal_review_status: Pending - initial DPA/terms requested 2026-02-28; Legal asked for dataflow diagram and retention policy (requested 2026-03-02)
security_review_status: Under review - Security requested network architecture diagram and sample SOC2 report; scheduled meeting with Pinecone SecOps 2026-03-09
comments: 2026-02-26 - Aisha Patel: Opening ticket. Product requests enterprise features and predictable pricing for upcoming Console search rollout. Attaching preliminary cost spreadsheet and pilot usage metrics.

2026-02-27 - Procurement (Miguel Santos): Reached out to Pinecone AE Jordan Lee for formal quote and enterprise terms. Requested SSO and networking requirements. Awaiting quote; will open PR to finance once PO estimate confirmed.

2026-03-02 - Legal (Nina Cho): We need a dataflow diagram showing what PII (if any) will be stored/processed in Pinecone and retention policy. Please attach to this ticket. Also requesting DPA redline window.

2026-03-03 - Security (Ravi Kapoor): Provided preliminary security questionnaire to Pinecone; scheduled joint call 2026-03-09 to review VPC peering and encryption at rest options. Also asked for SOC2 type 2 and pen test summary.
2026-03-05 - Finance (Leah Kim): Preliminary budget sign-off for up to $130k/year contingent on legal and security approvals. Please add final vendor quote and PO fields.

2026-03-11 - Procurement (Miguel Santos): Received updated quote from Pinecone including discounts for annual commit and 10 dedicated projects. Uploaded quote to vendor portal link. Preparing PO draft.
2026-03-12 - Legal (Nina Cho): Reviewed initial DPA; proposing three redlines around data deletion timelines and subprocessor notifications. Shared redline doc with vendor; awaiting response.
investigation_notes: Checked pilot usage metrics: average tps ~45, spikes to 120 during indexing windows; prefix cache reduces queries but production expected to double traffic.
Evaluated alternatives (Milvus, Qdrant) earlier in vendor evaluation doc; Pinecone chosen for mature managed features and existing pilot compatibility.
Security validated that VPC peering is supported; asked Pinecone for routing CIDR ranges and required firewall rules.
Finance reviewed cost model: committed discounts preferred to continuous metered usage; seeking final annual pricing to lock in budget.
resolution_notes: (pending) Next steps: finalize legal DPA redlines and confirm SOC2 evidence; procurement to issue PO after vendor acceptance of redlines.
Once contract signed: Infra to schedule VPC peering and SSO configuration with Pinecone (owners: Ravi Kapoor + DevOps team).
Procurement will provide final PO number and invoice instructions in this ticket and add vendor to vendor registry.
